nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a topological group, $R$ a topological ring and $M$ a topological abelian group that is a finite free $R$-module. Suppose that $G$ acts on $R$ by ring automorphisms and on $M$ by additive automorphisms, and that the actions of $G$ on $R$, of $G$ on $M$ and of $R$ on $M$ are jointly continuous. This is a continuous semilinear representation of $G$ on $M$ when $g \cdot (r x) = (g \cdot r)(g \cdot x)$ for…
